title: Peace Homeowner's Collection Vacation Rental
meta_description: Peace is a 1.00 bedroom, 2.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: 2322 EAST COUNTY HWY 30ABeachfront Serenity in the Heart of Seaside, FloridaWelcome to Peace, a pure and elegant beachfront cottage newly introduced to our rental collection and part of the exclusive Honeymoon Cottage series in Seaside, Florida. Perfectly tucked just behind the primary dune along the Gulf of Mexico, this romantic retreat offers breathtaking Gulf and sunset views with an unbeatable location—only three homes from beach access and one block from the Seaside Amphitheater and Central Square. With over 35 shops and restaurants just steps away, Peace truly delivers the best of beachfront living and walkable town charm.A Tranquil Arrival Along a Classic Seaside FootpathAccessed via a dreamy, shaded Seaside footpath framed by iconic coastal architecture, Peace immediately sets the tone for relaxation. Guests arrive to private driveway parking for one and enter on the ground level, where the sleeping quarters create a quiet, intimate retreat surrounded by dunes and sea breezes.Private Primary Suite with Screened Porch & Jacuzzi TubThe queen primary suite is thoughtfully designed with built-in storage, a flat-screen TV, and direct access to an expansive screened-in porch. This porch is a true sanctuary, featuring a private jacuzzi tub, privacy curtains, and serene dune views—an incredibly secluded space perfect for unwinding after a beach-filled day. The adjacent full bathroom includes a single vanity and a walk-in shower.Elevated Living with Panoramic Gulf ViewsUpstairs, the second level opens to a light-filled living space surrounded by large windows that showcase stunning Gulf views. The living room features a large wraparound sectional, ample seating, and a mounted flat-screen TV—ideal for cozy evenings in. Also on this level is an additional full bathroom with a walk-in shower, offering added comfort and convenience.Beachfront Porch Living & Sunset ViewsThe crown jewel of Peace is the expansive open-air beachfront porch, where the sights and sounds of the Emerald Coast take center stage. Enjoy bar-top seating for two, rocking chairs, and a hammock—all perfectly positioned to soak in unforgettable sunsets over the Gulf of Mexico. Whether sipping morning coffee or enjoying an evening nightcap, this porch delivers a front-row seat to Seaside’s natural beauty.Efficient Kitchenette for Easy Coastal LivingJust off the living area is a streamlined efficiency kitchenette, equipped with an under-counter refrigerator and essentials for light meals and refreshments (no oven or dishwasher). Designed for ease and simplicity, it complements the relaxed, romantic nature of this beachfront escape.A Romantic Seaside Getaway Designed for TwoPeace is the perfect hideaway for couples seeking a romantic beachfront cottage in Seaside, Florida. Whether you’re lounging to the sound of the waves, strolling to town for dinner, or watching the sunset from your private porch, every moment here feels intentional and serene. If your next Seaside escape calls for simplicity, beauty, and unmatched location—come be at Peace.* 3 night minimum Spring, Spring Break, Summer, and 2 night minimum Fall & Winter. Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign registration. FEATURES672 square feetPrivate Seaside residential beach access at East Ruskin Pavilion1-minute walk (108 feet) to beach accessEfficiency kitchen with coffee pot, microwave, toaster, 2-burner electric stovetop, and under-counter refrigerator (no oven or dishwasher)Access to Seaside amenities, including 3 swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts & 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and 2 complimentary rental bikes for pick up at Seaside Transit AuthorityDesignated off-street driveway parking for one vehiclePersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities providedGolf cart policy: A golf cart is considered a car; golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs require a golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR24-000433
